description: Correct a bug in the zinc-finger parser: pin the two Cys and two His by regex capture groups instead of taking the first two C and first H in the matched substring, then recount canonical fingers and re-extract the recognition quadruplets for ADNP2, ADNP and the human C2H2 background
code:
# =====================================================================
# Bug fix. The previous cell located the zinc-coordinating residues by
# taking the first two C and the first H inside the matched substring.
# That is wrong whenever an extra Cys sits next to C1 (ADNP2 ZF1 came
# out with C-x0-C) or a His sits inside the 12-residue spacer (ADNP2 ZF7
# came out with C-x4-H-x12-H). Here the four residues are pinned by
# regex capture groups, so their positions are exact.
# =====================================================================
import requests, re, numpy as np
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H_ = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}

STRICT = re.compile(r"C(.{2,4})C(.{12})H(.{3,5})H")
LOOSE  = re.compile(r"C(.{1,5})C(.{9,15})H(.{2,6})H")

def finger(seq, s, e, pad=4):
    """pin C1,C2,H1,H2 by capture groups; return spacing, spacer, recognition quadruplet"""
    w = seq[max(0, s-1-pad): min(len(seq), e+pad)]
    strict = STRICT.search(w)
    m = strict or LOOSE.search(w)
    if not m:
        return {"strict": False, "match": None, "spacing": None, "recog": None, "spacer": None}
    g1, g2, g3 = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
    # spacer g2 runs C2+1 .. H1-1, 1-indexed; recognition -1,+2,+3,+6 = spacer index L-6, L-4, L-3, L
    L = len(g2)
    idx = [L-6, L-4, L-3, L]
    recog = "".join(g2[i-1] for i in idx) if min(idx) >= 1 else None
    return {"strict": bool(strict), "match": m.group(0),
            "spacing": (len(g1), L, len(g3)), "recog": recog, "spacer": g2}

def zf_feats(acc):
    e = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.json?fields=sequence,ft_zn_fing" % acc,
                     timeout=90, headers=H_).json()
    sq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    return sq, sorted((f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"], f.get("description", ""))
                      for f in e.get("features", []) if f["type"] == "Zinc finger")

print("=" * 86)
print("Corrected per-finger parse. spacing = (C-x?-C, C-x?-H, H-x?-H); canonical is (2-4, 12, 3-5)")
res = {}
for acc, name in [("Q6IQ32", "ADNP2"), ("Q9H2P0", "ADNP")]:
    sq, zfs = zf_feats(acc)
    print("\n%s (%s), %d annotated zinc fingers" % (name, acc, len(zfs)))
    print("   #  range        UniProt description        canonical  spacing       recog(-1,+2,+3,+6)")
    out = []
    for i, (s, e, d) in enumerate(zfs, 1):
        f = finger(sq, s, e)
        out.append((i, s, e, d, f))
        print("  %2d  %4d-%-4d  %-26s  %-9s  %-12s  %s"
              % (i, s, e, (d or "")[:26], f["strict"], str(f["spacing"]), str(f["recog"])))
    nc = sum(o[4]["strict"] for o in out)
    print("  canonical C-x(2,4)-C-x(12)-H-x(3,5)-H: %d of %d" % (nc, len(out)))
    res[name] = out

# ---------------- background with the corrected parser
q = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00096+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=400&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_zn_fing,sequence")
j = requests.get(q, timeout=180, headers=H_).json()
bg_recog, per_prot = [], []
for e in j["results"]:
    sq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    zfs = [(f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"])
           for f in e.get("features", []) if f["type"] == "Zinc finger" and "C2H2" in (f.get("description") or "")]
    if not zfs: continue
    fs = [finger(sq, s, t) for s, t in zfs]
    bg_recog += [f["recog"] for f in fs if f["recog"]]
    per_prot.append(sum(f["strict"] for f in fs) / len(fs))
per_prot = np.array(per_prot)
print("\n" + "=" * 86)
print("human C2H2 background: %d proteins, %d recognition quadruplets" % (len(per_prot), len(bg_recog)))
print("per-protein fraction of canonical fingers: mean %.3f, median %.3f, sd %.3f"
      % (per_prot.mean(), np.median(per_prot), per_prot.std(ddof=1)))
for name in ("ADNP2", "ADNP"):
    fr = sum(o[4]["strict"] for o in res[name]) / len(res[name])
    print("  %-6s fraction canonical = %.3f  -> percentile %.1f, z = %.2f"
          % (name, fr, 100*(per_prot < fr).mean(), (fr - per_prot.mean())/per_prot.std(ddof=1)))

CONTACT = set("RKNQDESTH")
bgf = np.array([sum(a in CONTACT for a in r)/4 for r in bg_recog])
print("\nfraction of the four recognition positions with base-reading chemistry (R K N Q D E S T H)")
print("  background per finger: mean %.3f, sd %.3f (n=%d)" % (bgf.mean(), bgf.std(ddof=1), len(bgf)))
pf = {}
for name in ("ADNP2", "ADNP"):
    v = [(o[0], o[4]["recog"], sum(a in CONTACT for a in o[4]["recog"])/4)
         for o in res[name] if o[4]["recog"]]
    pf[name] = v
    m = np.mean([x[2] for x in v])
    print("  %-6s %s" % (name, "  ".join("ZF%d=%s(%.2f)" % x for x in v)))
    print("         mean %.3f, z = %.2f, percentile %.1f"
          % (m, (m - bgf.mean())/bgf.std(ddof=1), 100*(bgf < m).mean()))

# one-sample test: are the ADNP2 fingers' recognition positions depleted of base-reading chemistry?
from scipy import stats
for name in ("ADNP2", "ADNP"):
    v = np.array([x[2] for x in pf[name]])
    u, p = stats.mannwhitneyu(v, bgf, alternative="less")
    print("  Mann-Whitney %s fingers vs background (one-sided, less): U=%.0f, p=%.3f, n=%d"
          % (name, u, p, len(v)))

# ---------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4.2))
ax[0].hist(per_prot, bins=20, color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white")
for nm, c in [("ADNP2", "#d1495b"), ("ADNP", "#e8a33d")]:
    fr = sum(o[4]["strict"] for o in res[nm]) / len(res[nm])
    ax[0].axvline(fr, color=c, lw=2.5, label="%s %.2f" % (nm, fr))
ax[0].set_xlabel("fraction of annotated C2H2 fingers with canonical spacing")
ax[0].set_ylabel("human C2H2 proteins (n=%d)" % len(per_prot))
ax[0].legend(fontsize=9); ax[0].set_title("Finger spacing")
ax[1].hist(bgf, bins=np.arange(-0.125, 1.26, 0.25), color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white", rwidth=0.9)
for nm, c in [("ADNP2", "#d1495b"), ("ADNP", "#e8a33d")]:
    ax[1].axvline(np.mean([x[2] for x in pf[nm]]), color=c, lw=2.5,
                  label="%s mean %.2f" % (nm, np.mean([x[2] for x in pf[nm]])))
ax[1].set_xlabel("base-reading chemistry at -1, +2, +3, +6")
ax[1].set_ylabel("human C2H2 fingers (n=%d)" % len(bgf))
ax[1].legend(fontsize=9); ax[1].set_title("Recognition-position chemistry")
labs = ["ZF%d" % x[0] for x in pf["ADNP2"]]
ax[2].bar(range(len(labs)), [x[2] for x in pf["ADNP2"]], color="#d1495b")
ax[2].axhline(bgf.mean(), color="grey", ls="--", lw=1.2, label="human mean %.2f" % bgf.mean())
ax[2].set_xticks(range(len(labs))); ax[2].set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel("fraction base-reading"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_title("ADNP2 fingers, per finger")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
